name: Restaurant AI Consultant API
description: One-call full restaurant consulting audit. /full-consulting-audit returns an executive_summary, restaurant_health_score, revenue_risk_score, marketing/operations/review/competition sub-scores, a 90_day_action_plan, and an estimated_revenue_impact. Granular endpoints expose revenue-leak diagnosis, competitor benchmarking, and plan generation. Built for advisory, consultant, and operator agents.

pricing_model.free_tier: GET / discovery is free; new keys include $5 trial credit.

useCases: Produce a complete, client-ready consulting audit for a restaurant in one call.
Quantify and rank where a restaurant is leaking revenue each month.
Benchmark a restaurant against its 5 nearest competitors.
Generate a phased 90-day turnaround plan with revenue impact per initiative.

agentUseCases.workflow: Sell a fixed-fee audit; call /full-consulting-audit once per engagement and deliver the structured report.
Run /diagnose-revenue-leaks across a portfolio and prioritize the highest-loss locations.
Quarterly self-audit; track health and risk scores over time.

compliance: GDPR: business-data-focused; ensure lawful basis where personal data appears

human_approval_required._note: Read/analysis only; no outward-facing or irreversible actions, so no execution gate required.

chain_to.reason: Drill into a single growth lever from the audit.
Package the audit as a pitch deliverable.

recommended_actions_priority_order.action: Address the highest revenue_risk_score driver first.
Execute the 90_day_action_plan week_1 items and set KPIs.

examplePrompts: Give me a full consulting audit for Trattoria Sole with a 90-day plan.
Where is this restaurant leaking the most revenue each month?
Benchmark this restaurant against its 5 closest competitors.
What's this restaurant's health score and biggest risk?
